Starter title wraps across PDF lines. Normalize layout whitespace for text assertions, retain exact metadata assertion and save artifacts before checks.

Child PATH replacement alone did not guarantee expected no-runtime diagnostic on Windows. Conflicting runtime selectors now prevent probes deterministically and are asserted along with exit4 and unchanged output.

Public Linux ARM64 PDF acceptance selected preinstalled rootless Podman, which rejected the CPU cgroup controller. The new harness explicitly selects and preflights the hosted Docker default context. Separate run 43496517451 passes all eight jobs using the unchanged tag and release binaries. The original failed run is retained; the reason Docker auto-discovery fell through was not recorded.
